svg.aria-label: British Virgin Islands real island coastlines, neighbouring United States Virgin Islands and nine locations
svg.metadata: Geography: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian ADM1 2017 VGB (target) and VIR (United States Virgin Islands context), simplified release; CC BY 3.0 IGO, derived source geoBoundaries VGB-ADM1-34233081 and corresponding VIR ADM1; source repository robit-man/tiny-atlas/elevation_model/geojson/ADM1/{VGB,VIR}.geojson. Geographic shapes retained in WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Map context is not part of the target territory.
